title: S4-RELATION-01 — Turn it around, and bring it back.
goal: An asymmetric red L (replay link: a bar at x 8-9, y 3-12 and a foot at x 10-13, y 11-12) is selected with one Magic Wand click. H then V turns it 180 degrees inside its box, Commit keeps it, Undo returns the exact original and Redo the exact turn. A horizontal flip alone is also exact and undoable. Expected composites are drawn independently by replay links: 180 degrees f3f88505, horizontal flip bb308505.
cliOnly: four 90-degree RotSprite turns with backups of every layer between them

steps.why: The replay draws exactly the L.
The selection is lifted and the transform toolbar is shown.
H then V turned the L exactly 180 degrees within its box.
One Undo returns the exact original L.
A horizontal flip alone mirrors the L exactly.
Undo returns the exact original again.
